result.question: Whom did the old prophet claim an angel had told him to bring home for a meal?

readings.support: Bring him back with you to your house so that he may eat bread and drink water. | So the man of God returned with him

assessments.reason: The passage explicitly identifies the person as “the man of God,” whom the old prophet said an angel told him to bring back to eat and drink.

result.reason: The text directly states the old prophet claimed an angel said to bring back “the man of God” to his house to eat and drink.
